Trump proposes new presidential retreat at his golf club

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed establishing a new presidential retreat, referred to as a "new Camp David," at one of his private golf clubs. Trump stated that the idea is "a great idea" and that he wants to turn his Florida golf course into a presidential retreat.
